quick: 12.5 to 50 mg twice daily (equivalent to racemic metoprolol 25 to 100 mg twice daily)
summary: S-metoprolol is the active enantiomer of metoprolol, marketed in India; the tartrate is the immediate-release salt. Half the racemic dose gives a similar effect.

dosage.d: 12.5 to 50 mg twice daily (equivalent to racemic metoprolol 25 to 100 mg twice daily)
dosage.n: Titrate to heart rate and BP; ER succinate is preferred in heart failure

admin: Use only as the finished product directs
moa: Selective beta-1 adrenoceptor blockade lowers heart rate, contractility and renin release.

absolute: Second- or third-degree AV block, sick sinus syndrome without pacemaker

preg: Use if needed; monitor fetal growth and neonatal bradycardia/hypoglycaemia
hepatic: Reduce dose in severe hepatic impairment (extensive hepatic metabolism, CYP2D6)

major: Verapamil, diltiazem (IV especially): heart block, asystole
moderate: CYP2D6 inhibitors (fluoxetine, paroxetine, bupropion): raised levels

counsel: Do not stop suddenly: taper over 1 to 2 weeks
missed: Take when remembered unless within 4 hours of the next dose.
overdose: Bradycardia and hypotension: atropine, IV fluids, glucagon, high-dose insulin euglycaemia, pacing.
